Maria (Finance): Got an invoice from AcmeCorp for the Private deployment renewal — platform fee shows $45,000 instead of the contracted $30,000 and support tier billed as Enterprise instead of Standard. Anyone see why?
Andrew (Sales): Ack. Can you attach the invoice PDF? @Sanjay did we record any support upgrade in CRM?
Sanjay (AcctExec): No upgrade on our side. Order S-10023 is for Standard Support. Customer never requested Enterprise.
Maria (Finance): Pasting the invoice lines:```
Invoice: 9421
Line 1: Private Platform Fee — $45,000
Line 2: Support (Enterprise) — $12,000
Line 3: Usage true-up — $0
Total: $57,000
```
Julie (Billing): Thanks — looks like platform fee amount and support mapping are incorrect. Could be a pricing tier mapping in the private-licensing connector.
billing-bot: Invoice 9421 created by billing-sync (job id bsync-2023-09-12).
Andrew (Sales): I'm happy to approve a credit if it's our error. @Julie can billing reissue a corrected invoice + credit memo? We need PO# to match.
Maria (Finance): PO is PO-77832 and effective renewal date is 2025-02-01. Customer expects corrected docs before renewal processes.
Julie (Billing): I'll open a billing ticket and escalate. Quick questions: 1) Should the credit be applied against the platform fee only? 2) Do we also need to adjust support line to Standard rate ($6,000)?
Sanjay (AcctExec): Credit should cover the overcharged platform fee ($15k) and correct support to Standard ($6k). So net credit = $15k + $6k = $21k, but since Enterprise was billed $12k, we only need to credit the $6k delta for support plus $15k platform fee = $21k total. Confirmed per order history.
Maria (Finance): Confirmed. Please also ensure the true-up clause isn't being triggered — usage shows under commit for this term.
Julie (Billing): Noted. I'll request void + reissue of invoice 9421 and create credit memo CM-518. Target to have corrected invoice and credit issued by EOD Thu 2025-02-06. Need approvals from Sales (Andrew) and Finance (Maria) in the ticket.
Andrew (Sales): Approved. I'll send a short note to the customer explaining: billing error, corrected invoice + credit forthcoming, renewal unchanged.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-518 (priority P2) linked to invoice 9421 and order S-10023.
Maria (Finance): Thanks. Once the credit posts, please tag me for reconciliation. Also add a note to the private-licensing mapping config so this mapping issue doesn't recur.
Julie (Billing): Will do. Assigning to billing team member and leaving a follow-up to update mapping config and add integration test.
Sanjay (AcctExec): I'll double-check CRM order metadata to ensure no mismatch on support tier going forward.
Maria (Finance): Great — appreciate the quick response.
Andrew (Sales): :thumbsup:
Julie (Billing): I'll update BILL-518 with timeline and upload corrected invoice when ready.
